title: Sphynx Cat Artist at Work
description: A hairless sphynx cat wearing glasses and a colorful scarf sits at a wooden desk under a lamp, drawing in a sketchbook with a pencil. The surreal scene features floating bubbles containing dancing women in orange floral dresses, musical notes, an alien head, and vibrant paint drips against a cosmic purple background.
prompt: A hairless sphynx cat with black glasses and a colorful scarf sits at a wooden desk under a warm yellow lamp, drawing in a spiral sketchbook with a pencil while paint drips from its body, surrounded by transparent bubbles containing dancing women in orange floral dresses, floating musical notes, an alien head, and glowing orbs against a dark cosmic purple space background with stars and nebulae, whimsical surreal scene
